description: Monthly EMI, total interest and total repayment for a home, car or personal loan in India (reducing-balance method, monthly rests). Optional part-payments (a yearly amount, and a one-time amount in a chosen year) keep the EMI and shorten the loan, as banks do by default; the result then shows the interest saved and when the loan ends.

one_time_part_payment.description: Optional one-time extra payment, in rupees (default 0)

one_time_part_payment_year.description: Year whose last EMI the one-time payment is made with (default 5)

yearly_part_payment.description: Optional extra payment made with every 12th EMI, in rupees (default 0)

name: calculate_loan_emi
title: Loan EMI
